description: Discovers and verifies the two structural product identities c_3·c_4 = c_8 and c_3·c_6 = c_9 (symbolic in b, exact at silver ratio). The first identity derives c_4 = c_8/c_3 = -2·b⁴, answering the 'c_4 categorical origin' question with a Markov-trace-style multiplicative law (modulo categorical proof of the product identity itself). EXPLORATORY; no fit.
verdict: Two product identities found. c_8 = c_3·c_4 derives c_4 = -2·b⁴ from c_3 (J_Hopf) and c_8 (σ-action seed) — closing the c_4 categorical-origin question modulo proof of the underlying multiplicative law. c_5 (averaging-resonance) remains outside the product algebra.
